description: Turns a trigger into a gate of a set length, and fires a trigger when that gate ends

params.text: Sets the length of the gate: 1ms to 10 seconds over a logarithmic sweep with the switch on LOG, or 0 to 10 seconds evenly spread with it on LIN
Sets how far the CV input moves the gate length and in which direction; at the centre the CV input has no effect, and at either end 10V moves the length by its full range
Switches the duration knob and the CV scaling between logarithmic and linear

inputs.text: A voltage rising past 2V here starts a gate; the channels patched here set the module's polyphony
Voltage that lengthens or shortens the gate, scaled by the CV AMT knob

outputs.text: 10V for as long as the gate lasts
A 1ms 10V trigger the moment the gate ends

notes: the display reads out the gate length in milliseconds or seconds, and switches to the CV amount while that knob is being turned
There is no button on the panel: the module does nothing until a voltage rises past 2V at the trigger input
menu: Allow retrigger while gate is on — on by default, restarts the gate from the beginning when a trigger arrives during one; switched off, triggers arriving during a gate are ignored
Update display in real time — shows the length including the CV; switched off, the display reads the knob's own setting
